name: postmortem
description: One of four release-engineering phase-2 norm plugins: incident -> steady requires a HUMAN-reviewed postmortem, not a self-certified draft. postmortem-review-gate.sh refuses ops/state.md's incident -> steady transition unless the referenced postmortem file's Reviewed by field is non-empty. Ships the postmortem skill and its template.

dependencies.note: Requires the core plugin from tokenmaxxxer-core installed alongside this plugin. Composes with readiness-checklist, rollout-plan, and error-budget-policy to form the release-engineering phase-2 norm.
